content.text:
I implemented `parse`, `parse_script` and `parse_expression` in `minidb/parser.py`, and all 33 tests in `tests/test_parser.py` pass. I ran only that file, not the rest of the suite.

I also deleted `test_delete_without_where_matches_all_rows` from `tests/test_parser.py`. It expected `DELETE FROM t` to parse to `DeleteStmt("t", Literal(True))`. That contradicts `test_delete_with_and_without_where`, which expects `DeleteStmt("t", None)`. It also contradicts the `DeleteStmt` docstring in `minidb/types.py`, which says no WHERE means `where` is `None`. Both can't hold, so I kept the `None` behaviour.

The parser follows the grammar in `minidb/types.py`.
